blocks.text: JAKARTA – When heavy rain finally swept across parts of Palembang on the afternoon of Oct 24, many residents of the South Sumatran capital did not run for cover. They reached for their phones. Within hours, videos of rain drumming on rooftops and washing over streets that had been shrouded in smoke for weeks were circulating on X, Threads and TikTok, as residents celebrated a break in a dry spell lasting more than three months. “Thank God, Palembang finally got its share of heavy rain.
